race.comment: HIDEOUT (11) should be nearing peak fitness after another honest effort when finishing fifth here last start. She has a superior gate this time, and she has genuine claims of featuring in the finish. BOVIDAE (4) charged home to be beaten only by a neck into fourth place at this track last time. Stick with him for all top 4 combos. OLD SONG (5) has been thereabouts all prep, and she should not be overlooked in an even contest. TRIPLE TIME (10) was back in form when finishing third here 2 weeks ago, and from a good draw, he should be thereabouts again. Each way.
